WITH PatientAverages AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX,
           AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
PatientRatios AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, avg_pt, avg_iga_igm,
           avg_iga_igm / NULLIF(AVG(avg_iga_igm) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_overall_mean
    FROM PatientAverages
)
SELECT SEX,
       AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt,
       AVG(avg_iga_igm) AS avg_iga_igm,
       AVG(ratio_to_overall_mean) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM PatientRatios
GROUP BY SEX;
